description: Several small incidents occurred during the day, and the lead needs a reliable chronological account before filing a formal summary upward. All locations and election offices are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 42-year-old polling site lead closing out an unusually eventful election day
user_profile.context: Each incident was handled in the moment, but the sequence and overlap are already becoming difficult to reconstruct accurately
user_profile.communication_style: Chronological and calm, wants a factual timeline rather than an emotional recap

fact_sheet.fact: Maya Singh was the designated Polling Site Lead for the Northwood Community Center location.
Poll workers Liam Johnson and Sarah Kim were assigned to the voter check-in stations for the entire day.
Poll workers Omar Hassan and Chloe Garcia were assigned to ballot assistance and machine monitoring.
The polling location at Northwood Community Center, 1550 Arbor Lane, officially opened to voters at 07:00 on November 5, 2024.
At 07:15, the ballot scanner at Station 3, a Dominion ImageCast Precinct 2 model, rejected three consecutive ballots.
The cause of the scanner rejections at Station 3 was identified as a misaligned internal paper guide.
Poll worker Omar Hassan realigned the paper guide on the Station 3 scanner at 07:18, which resolved the issue.
Maya Singh recorded the scanner malfunction and resolution as entry #1 in the official site logbook at 07:20.
The polling site was equipped with a total of five Dominion ImageCast Precinct 2 ballot scanners.
The site began the day with an inventory of 2,500 pre-printed paper ballots.
At 09:42, a voter named Mr. Albert Finch stated his name was not found on the electronic poll book.
Poll worker Sarah Kim used the county lookup tool and verified Mr. Finch was correctly registered at the Redwood Elementary School precinct.
Mr. Albert Finch was issued a provisional ballot at 09:48 per Sterling County Elections procedure.
At 09:50, Maya Singh called David Chen, Field Operations Supervisor at Sterling County Elections (555-0182), to confirm the provisional ballot protocol.
As of the 12:00 noon count, a total of 312 voters had cast their ballots.
At 13:15, a power strip connected to voting Stations 1 and 2 tripped, causing a momentary power loss to the scanners.
Liam Johnson reset the tripped power strip at 13:16, immediately restoring power to the affected stations.
The internal battery backups on the Dominion scanners at Stations 1 and 2 functioned correctly, preventing any data loss or machine shutdown.
At 14:30, a mid-day resupply of 500 additional ballots was delivered from the Sterling County Elections warehouse.
The ballot resupply delivery was signed for by Maya Singh; the courier's name was Mark O'Connell.
At 16:05, a slow water leak was discovered originating from a pipe under the sink in the men's restroom.
At 16:07, Chloe Garcia placed a 'Caution: Wet Floor' sign and a collection bucket at the site of the restroom leak.
Maya Singh sent a text message to the community center's facility manager, Ms. Janice Gable, at 16:10 to report the water leak.
As of the 18:00 (6 PM) count, a total of 745 voters had cast their ballots.
At 19:55, a voter named Ms. Evelyn Reed was the last person to get in line before the official closing time.
The doors to the polling place were officially closed to new arrivals at exactly 20:00.
The last voter in line, Ms. Evelyn Reed, successfully cast her ballot at 20:12.
The total number of voters who cast ballots at the Northwood Community Center location for the day was 815.
The site processed a total of 12 new same-day voter registrations on Election Day.
The formal process of shutting down and securing all voting machines began at 20:15.
Final ballot counts were printed from all five machines and reconciled with the poll book by 20:45.
The single provisional ballot cast by Mr. Finch was sealed in security envelope #PV-S0341.
Two authorized Sterling County Elections officials collected all sealed ballot boxes and secured equipment at 21:30.
Maya Singh submitted the final digital end-of-day report via the 'PollChief' portal at 21:55, receiving confirmation ID #EOD-NC-78B34.
